title: 04 · One build, promoted unchanged through every environment
question: The same build gets deployed to all environments. Can a Spring AOT + AOT-cache image be built once and promoted dev → qa → prod unchanged?

answer.pass: Yes. The image was built once, pushed, and only its digest was deployed to dev1, qa1 and prod1. The image contains no environment names, hosts or settings; each environment brought its own through env vars and a mounted config directory. All three ran the same image and reported the same build, each with its own settings, and all three used the AOT cache baked into it.
answer.fail: Not as expected: at least one result differs from the known behaviour. See 'Unexpected results' for what differed and what to check.
answer.inconclusive: Some results couldn't be judged; rerun the example.

tested: One build of one-image-app, pushed to a local registry (localhost:5001); the local tag is deleted so every environment pulls the digest.
A scan of the image (bundled config files and image env vars) for environment markers: env names, database hosts, on-call addresses.
Promotion: dev1 → qa1 → prod1, each deployed from the same digest with its own envs/<env>/app.env and envs/<env>/config.
Per environment: which digest runs, profiles, a setting from its config directory, and whether the JVM used the AOT cache with that environment's JVM flags.

promoted-digest.label: promoted artifact (digest)
promoted-digest.why: Information: the one artifact every environment runs.

scan.group: No environment config in the image
scan.label: occurrences in the image
scan.why: Everything environment-specific lives in envs/<env>/, outside the image, so the same image can go anywhere.
ifUnexpected: Something environment-specific was bundled: look for application-<env>.yml or hard-coded values in examples/04-one-image/app/src/main/resources.
Or the Dockerfile sets an environment-specific ENV.

started.label: started
started.why: Same image, valid settings per environment.
ifUnexpected: Read the startup log in the evidence.
Is the registry up (localhost:5001)? The environments pull the digest from it.

digest.label: runs the promoted digest
digest.why: Deployments reference the digest, not a tag, so what runs is exactly what was built and tested earlier.
ifUnexpected: Check IMAGE_REF in compose.yml is the digest ref (name@sha256:...).

profiles.label: profiles (from envs/<env>/app.env)
profiles.why: APP_ENV + APP_ENV_INDEX come from the environment's env file and become profiles at startup.

message.label: app.message (from envs/<env>/config)
message.why: The environment's config directory is mounted at /config and imported at startup (spring.config.import: optional:file:/config/).
ifUnexpected: Check the volume mount in compose.yml and envs/<env>/config/application.yml.

cache.label: AOT cache used with this env's JVM flags
cache.why: The environments' flags (different heap sizes; prod uses the training flags) are all compatible with the cache baked into the image.
ifUnexpected: Read the JVM's message in the evidence (from -Xlog:aot).
Did someone add an incompatible flag (e.g. ZGC on JDK 25) to envs/<env>/app.env?

across.images.label: distinct images running
ifUnexpected: An environment is running something else: compare the digests in the promotion checks.

across.builds.label: distinct build times reported by the apps
across.builds.why: Each app reports the build-info Maven stamped into its jar; one value means one build, seen from inside the apps.
ifUnexpected: Check the build-info section of each environment's /info in the evidence.

reproduce: make examples EX=04                      # build once, push, scan, promote, report
make -C examples/04-one-image status     # which digest each environment runs
make -C examples/04-one-image stop       # stop the registry and environments
